change_summary: Return an executable retry cadence for every non-terminal Question operation so external hosts wait once instead of spending model turns on tight polling.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill already owns foreground waiting on retry_after_seconds; its discovery description is corrected to retain configured Corvio authority without the over-broad connected Workspace phrase.

server_contract.note: ask_corvio and get_question now expose retry_after_seconds=30 while queued or running and omit it at terminal state.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.38 with collaboration contract 2026-09-13.13.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI 0.1.0-beta.31 consumes live contract discovery; it does not poll Remote MCP Question operations itself.

help_center.note: Public MCP Help and package guidance tell hosts to honor the returned retry floor before polling the same operation.

package_setup.note: OAuth, MCP endpoint and package installation steps are unchanged.

harness_and_mainline.note: The owning RFCs and logbook preserve the result-contract drift, generic cadence repair and trigger/transfer/countercase boundary.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; external directory review and independent Claude longitudinal acceptance remain separate evidence.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover queued/running retry hints, terminal omission, bounded tool descriptions, discovery wording and distribution parity; unchanged live J3T4 replay remains the effect gate.
